payload.summary: COUNTER (codex, quoted). Verdict CHANGE — the drafted position was partly refuted. Attack: 'Removing translate(6px, -4px) is an unverified visual change, and symmetric margin-inline reserves width but does not itself establish the intended outboard placement or preserve the current vertical optical alignment.' Verdict: 'Reserve the rotated card's horizontal footprint with margin-inline: calc((var(--card-h) - var(--card-w)) / 2), but retain or deliberately re-tune the nudge after visual verification; mirror its horizontal component and mirror every third-card-emphasis transform exactly.' Why: 'Rotation still paints 20px beyond each side of its 92px layout box, so space must be reserved. The 6px/-4px offset may be optical correction rather than overlap compensation; deleting it on theory alone is not justified.' Claude concedes: the margin half survives, the delete-the-nudge half does not. The nudge's purpose was asserted, never verified.
